title: Orders Standing Open on One Customer Profile
content:
## 1. How many orders may stand open

A customer of Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment may have as many orders open as they care to place, and the
number of orders standing on one profile is not limited. No ceiling is set on the count.

## 2. The same order line twice

A second order is never raised for the same order line reference while one stands placed, awaiting stock, scheduled or
out for delivery. The prohibition is bounded by the standing of the order already held: it runs while that earlier
order stands in one of those four standings.

Whether such an order already stands is read from the retailer's own record of the profile's orders before the new
order is raised — the stock number the order carries, the standing of that order, and the profile the order belongs
to — and not from the customer's account of what they have on order. The orders looked at are the orders of that same
profile. Two records standing on one profile and carrying the same stock number are told apart by the day each was placed and
the total billed on each.

## 3. One fulfilment service to one order

Lines needing different fulfilment services are placed as separate orders, because the fulfilment service is a
property of the order rather than of the line.

## 4. Business profiles

A business profile's orders are raised against its named buyers, and all of them are counted to the one profile.

## Points of judgement

**Is there a limit on how many orders one profile may have open?** There is none. The count is unlimited.

**What makes a second order for the same line objectionable?** That an order for the same order line reference stands
placed, awaiting stock, scheduled or out for delivery at the time the second is raised.

**May one order carry lines that need two different fulfilment services?** No. Those lines are placed as separate
orders, the fulfilment service being a property of the order.

**Whose account of the standing orders governs?** The retailer's record of that profile's orders, read before the
order is raised.
